card.name: Section names in cross-references
card.fires_on: Section titles inside label cross-references, such as [see Description (11)] or Clinical Pharmacology (12.3). It fires on the last part of the title, just before the section number or closing bracket.

modes.label: Clinical Pharmacology
modes.description: The ending of 'Clinical Pharmacology' in a bracketed cross-reference before a section number.

modes.label: Description or Usage section
modes.description: The section title word after 'see' or 'under', or the end of 'INDICATIONS AND USAGE'.

card.plain: It marks the name of another label section being pointed to, like 'see Clinical Pharmacology'.
